name: @teactjs/sqlite
description: SQLite storage driver, session store and plugin for Teact — bun:sqlite and better-sqlite3

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core --external @teactjs/storage --external @teactjs/plugin-sdk --external bun:sqlite --external better-sqlite3 && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
